_comment: Per-slug hand-written fields that beat every fetched source. Use when
Wikidata is wrong, or a Wikipedia intro is useless as a dex blurb.
Any subset of: com, family, iucn, avibase, ebird, blurb.
_ebird_comment: These two carried a different eBird code in apt.js's hand-written
EBIRD_CODES table than Wikidata's P3444 reports. eBird redirects
anonymous species pages to a login, so neither could be verified from
here - the hand-written values are kept because they were what the site
actually shipped, and this is where to correct them if they're wrong.
